'''2011 Worlds Day 2 Barry Alperstein LS Communing''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Barry Alperstein]] at [[2011 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Username '''MrFromMars'''. Sheet '''Mess Combo''' → Sorry About The Mess & Blaster Proficiency; shield 12 from Additional '''Chasm''' (V).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Communing]]
* '''Username:''' MrFromMars
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
